snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3772190/HALLOW_BLADE/

HALLOW BLADE is a dark fantasy action adventure set in a vast interconnected subterranean kingdom where you form an unbreakable bond with an ancient possessed sword hungry for souls and vengeance.
